changes.reason: leaf2 forwards guest_vlan (10.10.20.0/24) traffic to the spine, but the spine has no route back to leaf2's guest-facing path except via its leaf1-facing interfaces; with the spine's to-leaf1 next-hops pointing at leaf1 addresses, guest->dmz traffic loops through the spine and is dropped. Removing leaf2's redundant static routes makes 10.10.20.0/24 local to leaf1, so web1's reply for guest1 is delivered by leaf2 locally and guest1's traffic no longer loops via the spine.
rollback_commands: next-hop-groups group to-leaf1 { nexthop 1 { ip-address 10.255.0.4 admin-state enable } nexthop 2 { ip-address 10.255.0.6 admin-state enable } }
